WITH latest_inventory AS (
    SELECT
        i.ProductKey,
        sum(i.OnHandQuantity) AS total_on_hand
    FROM retail.FactInventory i
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT StoreKey, ProductKey, MAX(DateKey) AS max_date
        FROM retail.FactInventory
        GROUP BY StoreKey, ProductKey
    ) latest
        ON i.StoreKey = latest.StoreKey
       AND i.ProductKey = latest.ProductKey
       AND i.DateKey = latest.max_date
    GROUP BY i.ProductKey
),
avg_daily_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ProductKey,
        sum(SalesQuantity) / 90.0 AS avg_daily_qty
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    WHERE DateKey >= toDate('2009-10-03')
      AND DateKey <= toDate('2009-12-31')
    GROUP BY ProductKey
)
SELECT
    p.ProductName,
    li.total_on_hand,
    round(ads.avg_daily_qty, 4)                             AS avg_daily_sales_qty,
    round(li.total_on_hand / nullif(ads.avg_daily_qty, 0), 2) AS days_of_coverage
FROM latest_inventory li
JOIN avg_daily_sales ads ON li.ProductKey = ads.ProductKey
JOIN retail.DimProduct p  ON li.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
ORDER BY days_of_coverage ASC
LIMIT 20
